caption: LUM-1412 chrome clip affordance: a real 44x14 PTY against the real release binary. The startup header folds to one row at this height (`locale::header_folded_line`), and that row is 51 characters for 44 columns. Before LUM-1412 the shared writer stopped at the edge and painted `hints hidden on a short terminal — Alt+H sho` — a fragment indistinguishable from a sentence that ends there. After LUM-1412 the row gives up the last partial word whole and marks the cut: `hints hidden on a short terminal — Alt+H…`. The `probe` rows are the post-fix behaviour (an unmet probe is an XFAIL, not a failure, so a pre-fix binary can run this same scenario as the A side of an A/B); the `reject` rows are the pre-fix fragment and must stay absent. Row 1 is the header row (row 0 is `pi v0.1.0`).
